description: A caller-supplied policy installed at the INSTANCE, not per call, so DefaultStrings.java:685-686 (options.getTranslationFallbackPolicy().orElse(getTranslationFallbackPolicy())) is exercised in both directions for a policy that is not one of the three library singletons. Requesting es-AR against loaded es-AR, es-419, es with fallback en yields the four-candidate chain [es-AR, es-419, es, en], verified by execution. The instance policy continues only for es-AR and es-419, so it halts at es and forfeits the en catalog that holds Inst.OnlyInFallback unless a per-call policy replaces it. Inst.InEveryCatalog is the no-consultation control and Inst.MissingEverywhere exists nowhere. Three loaded locales share the primary language es, so tiebreakers lists that exact permutation.

en.Inst.OnlyInFallback: en: only the fallback catalog has this
